items.quote: went on to Laish, against a people at peace and secure. They attacked them
items.contrast: The people of Laish are the recipients of the attack, while the Danites are the attackers; Micah is only the person whose objects and priest were taken.
items.reason: The pronouns require resolving who attacked whom. The Danites went against the people at Laish and attacked them, so the key completely identifies the target.
